title: Napkin Contract Poster, But GO
task: Make a clean poster that turns the napkin contract story into a pump.fun GO piece. The joke should land fast: one look and you get it. Keep it usable for socials and the bounty board banner, not just a meme for your camera roll.
deliverables: 1 public image file in PNG or JPG, minimum 1600px wide
1 source file link (Figma, PSD, or AI) with edit access for review
1 short note (3–5 lines) explaining the concept and where GO branding sits

title: OpenMessi in Plain English Thread
task: Write a short thread that explains OpenMessi or the GO bounty flow in normal human language. No corporate smoke, che. Make it useful enough that a new person could read it and know what to click, what gets submitted, and how rewards get claimed.
deliverables: 1 live X thread link with at least 5 posts
1 screenshot showing the full thread is public and time-stamped
1 text doc or public note with the exact thread copy for moderation review

title: Build a Goal Call Soundboard Page
task: Build a tiny web page with 6 to 10 football-style goal-call buttons for GO. Think chants, mate-fueled drama, and a little World Cup tension. It should run in the browser, load fast, and be simple enough that people actually use it and share it.
deliverables: 1 public GitHub repo with setup instructions and license noted
1 live deployed link working on desktop and mobile
1 short screen recording showing every button works and audio plays

title: Commentary Dub for Cold GO Clip
task: Take a short GO-related clip and dub it like a football commentator calling a last-minute winner. Dry humor helps. Keep it safe, clean, and actually funny, not ten layers of noise with everyone shouting over each other.
deliverables: 1 finished video link posted publicly on X, TikTok, or YouTube Shorts
1 version of the raw video file or drive link for download
1 screenshot showing public view count and timestamp after posting

title: Find Three Real World Cup Communities
task: Find three active online communities where a World Cup 2026-flavored GO post would make sense without forcing it. No bot farms, no dead channels. I want the place, the vibe, the posting rules, and one honest angle for how GO fits there.
deliverables: 1 doc with 3 community links and member/follower counts
1 screenshot for each community showing recent activity within the last 7 days
1 short posting note for each: audience, rules, and suggested GO angle

title: World Cup Walkout Tunnel Edit
task: Make a short edit around the World Cup 2026 nerves before kickoff. Keep it about the tunnel, the walkout, the quiet before the noise — not just random goals, che. Use OpenMessi or the pump.fun GO bounty board as the concrete hook somewhere in the video or caption so it actually belongs here.
deliverables: Public video link (TikTok, X, Instagram Reels, or YouTube Shorts), kept live through the deadline
Screenshot showing the post caption and visible view count at the time of submission
A short note listing the clips/audio used and where OpenMessi or the bounty board appears

title: Design Three Rosario Mate Stickers
task: Design a 3-sticker mini pack we could actually use in chats. The theme is Leo, Rosario, mate, and World Cup 2026 tension — warm, funny, simple. Dale, make them clean enough that they still read at a small size.
deliverables: ZIP or drive link with 3 transparent PNG stickers, minimum 1024x1024
One preview sheet showing all 3 stickers in a single image
A short caption for each sticker explaining the joke or reference

title: Safe No-Look Pass Street Clip
task: Film a safe, legal football clip recreating the spirit of the no-look pass. Nothing reckless, nothing in traffic, nothing that bothers people. Work in one clear spoken or written nod to pump.fun GO or OpenMessi so the stunt is on-brand and checkable, viste.
deliverables: One public video post link, kept live through review
Uncut behind-the-scenes clip or a second angle proving it was your original recording
Screenshot of the post with timestamp and visible account handle
